rendered: The authors did not choose a melt-diffusion step of more than 20 hours to infiltrate the sulfur. In fact, they mention that their method is "significantly more scalable and less expensive" compared to other methods that traditionally employ long (>20 h) melt techniques. They instead used a low temperature (175 °C) isothermal vapor phase process lasting 1 h to infiltrate the sulfur into the micropores of the carbon spheres.
